st: Yukako Yamagishi Falls in Love, Part 2
d: Koichi plans to escape from Yukako by having Reverb find a payphone and contact Josuke and Okuyasu, but Yukako stays one step ahead of him  as Koichi begins to lose hope, Yukako goes to the phone and something unexpected happens.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Let's Go Eat Some Italian Food
d: Josuke and Okuyasu visit a new Italian restaurant where the chef, Tonio, decides what the customer will eat instead of offering a menu  Tonio offers Okuyasu water that has an unexpected effect on him.

Chili Pepper shows himself to Josuke  he seems to be more powerful than Jotaro, and he can travel anywhere electricity flows  Jotaro summons Josuke, Okuyasu and Koichi and tells them a certain someone approaches Morioh.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Chili Pepper, Part 2
d: Jotaro believes Chili Pepper will try to kill Joseph Joestar by attacking his boat, so he leaves Josuke and Koichi to defend the harbor  Josuke deals with his conflicting feelings toward Joseph.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: We Picked Up Something Crazy!
d: Josuke and the others capture Akira Otoishi and safely retrieve the bow and arrow, restoring peace to Morioh, but Josuke still can't seem to get closer to the father he just met, Joseph  they discuss Josuke's mother, then discover another Stand user.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Let's Go to the Manga Artist's House, Part 1
d: Koichi and Hazamada learn famous manga artist Rohan Kishibe lives in town, and they go to get an autograph  Rohan thrills the boys by offering a tour of his studio, but Koichi becomes frightened when he sees just how far Rohan takes his work.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Let's Go to the Manga Artist's House, Part 2
d: Koichi sneaks into Rohan's house and finds Rohan drawing manga at an incredible speed  Rohan can't stop himself from drawing after reading about Koichi's experiences, and he attempts to take another page from Koichi by using Heaven's Door.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Let's Go Hunting!
d: Jotaro unexpectedly invites Josuke to accompany him on a hunt for the rat that gained Stand abilities after Akira Otoishi shot it with the bow and arrow  they trace the rat by discovering strange evidence of the power it wields.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Rohan Kishibe's Adventure
d: Koichi and Rohan discover an alley not listed on any map and decide to explore it, but when they unexpectedly find themselves back where they started with no exit in sight, Rohan suspects a Stand user trapped them.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Shigechi's Harvest, Part 1
d: Josuke encounters a tiny Stand holding a coin and follows it to a new Stand user named Shigekiyo Yangyu, who sends his Stand to pick up all the loose change around town  Josuke comes up with a better use for Shigekiyo's Stand.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Shigechi's Harvest, Part 2
d: Josuke and the others head to the bank with their lottery ticket, but the bank clerk suspects foul play since someone else's name and phone number are written on the back  when he decides to call the number, Josuke takes desperate action.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Yukako Yamagishi Dreams of Cinderella
d: A depressed Yukako sees a mysterious shop called Salon Cinderella that creates faces to bring people fortune  she receives a new face that allows her to find love and discovers how well it works during a chance meeting with Koichi.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Yoshikage Kira Just Wants to Live Quietly, Part 1
d: When Shigechi accidentally takes Kira's sandwich bag by mistake, Kira chases after him.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Yoshikage Kira Just Wants to Live Quietly, Part 2
d: Yoshikage Kira tries to dispose of Shigechi when Shigechi discovers his secret  Shigechi fights back, but Kira's Stand, Deadly Queen, mortally wounds him  clinging to life, Shigechi tries to warn Josuke about Kira.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Heart Attack, Part 1
d: Jotaro and Koichi try to track down the owner of the button and run into the murderer, Yoshikage Kira, and his Stand  Koichi ignores Jotaro's order and decides to face Kira on his own.
